## Goal

Train neural surrogates for the expensive physics, starting with turbulent transport: deep
ensembles in JAX with physics structure built in (zero flux below threshold, positivity,
monotonicity in the gradients), running inside the M1 coupling loop behind the guard. Then RF
deposition and the pedestal. The transport surrogates learn TGLF from the M2 datasets, one
ensemble per machine, MAST-U and ITER.

## Acceptance criteria (fixed in the brief before work started)

1. Held-out accuracy meets the target in the configuration.
2. The surrogate is differentiable and runs inside the M1 loop.
3. The end-to-end speed-up is measured and reported.

M3 has no human gate in the brief. The brief left the accuracy target to the configuration; the
owner chose to set it after a first baseline ([OQ-18](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-18)). It was set on 3 Oct 2026 ([OQ-19](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-19)): median
relative error of the ensemble mean at most 0.30 on Q~e~ and on Q~i~ (cases with |Q| above 1
gyro-Bohm unit), on each machine's held-out split of dataset v3. The final monotone transport
ensembles now pass that target: [MAST-U: Q_e 17.8%, Q_i 25.2%; ITER: Q_e 7.2%, Q_i 10.8%; all meet the 30% target]{.claim}[C-129](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-129){.cid .st-measured}. The milestone remains in progress.

## Plan to completion

Follow the [action plan](../action-plan.qmd): resolve the performance blocker and complete
the EC production and ITER pedestal boundary contracts independently. Then label EC cases, agree accuracy
targets, train EC ensembles and integrate both responses. Prescribed MAST-U pedestal and
deferred IC follow the owner's revised scope. Close M3 only when all required tasks meet its criteria. M4 begins
after that acceptance.

## Deviations so far

- **ITER pedestal uses the owner-selected pretrained single network.** Its JAX port has
  numerical parity and derivative checks ([12 upstream scalar regression values agree within relative tolerance 1e-12]{.claim}[C-149](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-149){.cid .st-measured}, [12 focused tests pass in full and Tier-A-only modes]{.claim}[C-150](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-150){.cid .st-tested}), with
  no ensemble uncertainty inferred. MAST-U predictive closure and IC are deferred.
- **20 members for the TGLF-NN variants** (as in GA's model files), above the brief's 5–10. The
  baseline has 10.
- **Active learning moved from M2 to M3** ([OQ-18](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-18) a), since it needs a trained ensemble to choose
  the points.
- **Monotonicity imposed where TGLF itself is not monotone** ([OQ-20](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-20) 1): the surrogate departs
  from TGLF there by construction: [MAST-U: Q_e 3.14, Q_i 3.36; ITER: Q_e 2.51, Q_i 2.11 signed-log units]{.claim}[C-131](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-131){.cid .st-preliminary}. Sampled monotonicity checks are not
  a formal certificate.
- **Accuracy target measured on dataset v3**, not on the M2 datasets ([OQ-19](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/decisions.qmd#oq-19)); errors on the M2
  test splits are reported, not gated.
